messages:
lina: FYI scheduling a canary rollout tonight during the 22:00-23:00 change window. Model-serving v2.2, looking to start with a 5% canary then ramp to 25/50. Need agreement on guards and approval flow.
aj: +1 on the 5% start. Can we make the initial guard auto-rollback on p95 latency > 150ms and pause on error-rate > 0.5% ?
kevin: agree. Also want a telemetry check that compares output-sanity tests (prompt set) for regression > 2% to pause.
olga: SRE asks that we require at least one SRE approval for any rollout that changes routing or adds new kernels. We should also ensure the deploy-bot's automated checks run before approvals are even allowed.
maria: is the deploy-bot currently able to latch on model-level telemetry? Last I checked it only looked at infra metrics.
deploy-bot: automations: started preflight for canary v2.2; running infra checks, verifying capacity and health endpoints. To add custom guards, include them in --guards flag or in rollout yaml.
aj: examples pls? would like to add ML-quality guard.
kevin: here's a sample snippet you can paste into release config:
```
canary:
  split: 0.05
  guards:
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      threshold: 150
      action: rollback
    - metric: error_rate_percent
      threshold: 0.5
      action: pause
    - metric: prompt_regression_percent
      threshold: 2
      action: pause
```
lina: perfect. ops question: do we require two explicit approvals (one eng, one SRE) or allow the release-coordinator to approve after automated checks pass?
release-coordinator: policy says for routing changes we need one eng + one SRE signoff. we can make an exception if the automated regression check + infra health pass AND the rollout is <= 5% for at least 30 minutes. but that needs explicit config in the release ticket.
olga: I'd prefer no exceptions; manual SRE approval prevents accidental kernel regressions. Could we at least have an auto-notify that posts a summary dashboard link and a preflight report?
maria: we can add a lightweight dashboard snapshot that includes p95, error-rate, and sample outputs diff. I'll add a dashboard permalink to the deploy-bot preflight.
deploy-bot: note: to trigger manual approvals add reviewers to the PR or run `/deploy request-approval @olga @kevin`. Approvers can then click approve in the console. Audit logs will be emitted to the release channel.
aj: one last thing: need to handle rollback routing smoothly. If rollback triggers, traffic should fall back to the pinned model variant with warm KV cache if available to avoid cold-start latency spike.
kevin: noted. runtime team will ensure fallback model warmed in pool during canary.
lina: action items: maria add dashboard snapshot to preflight; kevin ensure fallback warmup; olga confirm SRE will approve tonight; aj to attach guard yaml to the release PR. If SRE doesn't approve by 21:30 we'll postpone.
olga: I'll be online and will review by 21:15. :thumbsup: 
release-coordinator: logging this as release 2026-03-18-canary-42. I'll queue the deploy-bot run at 22:00. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: `deploy start --canary-config=pr-8421 --at=2026-03-18T22:00Z`. Preflight report: https://deploy/reports/8421
lina: thanks, closing loop. :eyes:
